title: Sahara Sailor Water Bottle 1 L — Tritan, BPA-Free, with Time Markers
short_description: Sahara Sailor water bottle with 1 litre capacity made of BPA-free Tritan, with a flip-top lid, time markers and a cleaning sponge. For camping, sport, school and everyday use.
long_description: The Sahara Sailor water bottle (model WBW001) holds 1 litre and is made of BPA-free Tritan. According to the Amazon listing it has a flip-top lid with a locking function and is leak proof. Time markers on the bottle remind you to drink regularly. The Deep Sea version has a matte finish and the bottle weighs 290 g. According to Amazon the package includes a 1000 ml bottle and a cleaning sponge. Hand wash only. Please check the size and the exact scope of delivery on the Amazon product page before buying.
buying_angle: Useful for camping, hiking, sport and school when you want a large water bottle with time markers as a drinking reminder.
